newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Power supply work to hit Bucharest bourse trade.
newsitem.headline: Power supply work to hit Bucharest bourse trade.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said on Wednesday its session the next day would be delayed by two hours due to work on its power supply system.
The bourse's Thursday four-hour trading session will start at 11 a.m. (0815 GMT) instead of 9.15 a.m.(0615 GMT), a bourse statement said.
The Bucharest exchange trades 35 stocks in Monday-to-Friday weekly sessions.
